title: Concepts rank globally with associations computed once, and carry a ranked order
description:
What: the knowledge snapshot computes each concept's association count once on change and the wiki index sorts globally before paging, giving concept pages a ranked order under the one rule where it applies. Delivers the ordering parts of PPY-c63f18; do not duplicate that story's views, link to it.
Why: MoM sorts concepts after rendering because core exposes no global order.
Acceptance:
Scenario: Page two never holds a more connected concept than page one
  Given 500 concepts with known association counts
  When the wiki index is paged
  Then ordering is global across pages
Scenario: A change recomputes only what it touches
  Given one Reference is added
  When the snapshot updates
  Then only the affected concepts' counts are recomputed
